module_summary: System-on-Chip top: routes data from 4 input channels through FIFOs, arbitrates with round-robin to select a FIFO, multiplexes its data, and transmits via UART.

anchors.name: ch_valid
anchors.why: Input handshake signal indicating valid data on channel.

anchors.name: ch_ready
anchors.why: Output backpressure signal from FIFO to each input channel.

anchors.name: fifo_valid
anchors.why: Valid signals from all 4 FIFOs requesting arbitration.

anchors.name: fifo_pop
anchors.why: Read enable to selected FIFO computed from grant and tx handshake.

anchors.name: gnt
anchors.why: One-hot grant vector selecting which FIFO data to send.

anchors.name: gnt_valid
anchors.why: Arbitration valid signal indicating a FIFO was selected.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Valid signal to UART indicating data ready to transmit.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: Ready signal from UART indicating ready to accept next byte.

anchors.name: tx_byte
anchors.why: Multiplexed data byte selected from granted FIFO.

anchors.name: uart_busy
anchors.why: Status output indicating UART transmitter busy.

groups.name: Input Channel Interface
groups.description: Handshake and data from 4 input channels, routed to FIFOs.

groups.name: FIFO Interconnect
groups.description: Valid and ready signals between FIFOs and arbitrator.

groups.name: Round-Robin Arbitration
groups.description: Selects one FIFO output per cycle using round-robin priority.

groups.name: TX Handshake
groups.description: Valid and ready handshake between arbiter and UART.

groups.name: Data Multiplexer
groups.description: One-hot mux selecting data from granted FIFO.

groups.name: UART Output Interface
groups.description: Serial transmit output and busy status.
